1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 1 coupled axes; angle band ±14°, speed band ±10°/s; motor lag 0.4s, coupling 0.0; gust rate 28°/s changes across 2.6s.
1.natural_language: Keep the sculpture aligned with the dashed world-plumb reference against changing wind. Lift the gear covers to inspect each motor winding and its cross-axis gears: positive dial directions vary between rigs. Inspection is safe before or during motion and stays visible. Steer the motor dials and anticipate their inertia. Hold all active angles and speeds inside their visible green bands for ten consecutive seconds. Leaving a band clears progress and allows correction. Early certification or the 90-second run limit ends the episode; later attempts cannot pass.

full.summary: Grab and drag each motor handwheel handle; its position sets a persistent signed motor drive. Lift motor gear covers to inspect winding directions and cross-axis effects; the same facts are exposed in both modes.

simplified.summary: Click the same signed motor drive directly on a rail. No aim, braking, alignment or wind compensation is automated. Lift motor gear covers to inspect winding directions and cross-axis effects; the same facts are exposed in both modes.
